Calculator

It can perform various mathematical operations on numbers, 
such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, exponentiation, root extraction, trigonometry, logarithm, etc.

It has different levels of complexity and functionality.

#BlueJ class context comment0.target=CalculatorImpl comment0.text= \ A\ model\ for\ an\ RPN\ calculator\ using\ the \ {@link\ EDU.ksu.cis.calculator.LargeInteger}\ class. \ @author\ Rod\ Howell \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ (howell@cis.ksu.edu) comment1.params=v comment1.target=CalculatorImpl(calculator.CalculatorUI) comment1.text= \ Constructs\ a\ new\ CalculatorImpl\ using\ the\ given\ user\ interface,\ base\ 10, \ and\ sticky\ bases. comment2.params=v\ b comment2.target=CalculatorImpl(calculator.CalculatorUI,\ int) comment2.text= \ Constructs\ a\ new\ CalculatorImpl\ using\ the\ given\ user\ interface\ and\ base, \ with\ sticky\ bases. comment3.params=v\ s comment3.target=CalculatorImpl(calculator.CalculatorUI,\ boolean) comment3.text= \ Constructs\ a\ new\ CalculatorImpl\ using\ the\ given\ user\ interface\ and \ the\ given\ setting\ for\ sticky\ bases,\ in\ base\ 10. comment4.params=v\ b\ s comment4.target=CalculatorImpl(calculator.CalculatorUI,\ int,\ boolean) comment4.text= \ Constructs\ a\ new\ CalculatorImpl\ using\ the\ given\ user\ interface,\ base,\ and \ setting\ for\ sticky\ bases. comment5.params=op\ input comment5.target=void\ doOperation(calculator.Operation,\ java.lang.String) comment5.text= \ Performs\ the\ given\ operation.\ \ If\ input\ is\ non-null,\ it \ is\ treated\ as\ the\ top\ of\ the\ stack.\ \ If\ input\ is\ ""\ or\ "-",\ it\ is \ interpreted\ as\ "0".\ \ Operands\ are\ taken\ from\ the\ top \ of\ the\ stack\ so\ that\ the\ top\ element\ is\ the\ last\ operand.\ \ The\ result \ (if\ any)\ is\ pushed\ onto\ the\ stack.\ \ When\ the\ operation\ is\ complete, \ the\ element\ that\ then\ resides\ at\ the\ top\ of\ the\ stack\ (if\ any)\ is \ reported\ to\ the\ user\ interface.\ \ If\ an\ exception\ or\ error\ is\ thrown, \ the\ stack\ will\ be\ restored\ to\ its\ original\ contents,\ if\ possible. \

\ The\ following\ classes\ of\ operations\ are\ supported\: \

    \
  • \ {@link\ Push}\ -\ If\ input\ is\ null,\ a\ copy\ of\ the\ top\ of\ the\ \ \ \ \ \ \ stack\ is\ pushed.\ \ Otherwise,\ input\ is\ simply\ accepted\ as \ \ \ \ \ \ the\ new\ top\ of\ the\ stack.\ \ Unrecognized\ subclasses\ of \ \ \ \ \ \ {@link\ EDU.ksu.cis.calculator.Operation}\ are\ treated\ as\ Push. \
  • \ {@link\ Pop}\ -\ Removes\ the\ top\ from\ the\ stack. \
  • \ {@link\ ClearStack}\ -\ Empties\ the\ stack. \
  • \ {@link\ RotateUp}\ -\ Moves\ the\ element\ at\ the\ bottom\ of\ the\ stack\ to\ \ \ \ \ \ \ the\ top. \
  • \ {@link\ RotateDown}\ -\ Moves\ the\ element\ at\ the\ top\ of\ the\ stack\ to\ the \ \ \ \ \ \ bottom. \
  • \ {@link\ EDU.ksu.cis.calculator.ConvertBase}\ -\ Converts\ the\ top\ of\ \ \ \ \ \ \ the\ stack\ to\ the\ base\ specified\ by\ \ \ \ \ \ \ {@link\ EDU.ksu.cis.calculator.ConvertBase\#getBase()\ op.getBase()}. \ \ \ \ \ \ If\ the\ stack\ is\ empty,\ simply\ reports\ the\ new\ base\ to\ the\ user \ \ \ \ \ \ interface. \
  • \ {@link\ EDU.ksu.cis.calculator.EncodedOperation}\ -\ Performs\ the\ \ \ \ \ \ \ operation\ specified\ by\ the\ given\ subclass\ of\ EncodedOperation. \
\ @throws\ EmptyDequeException\ \ If\ the\ operation\ requires\ more\ operands\ than \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ exist\ on\ the\ stack. comment6.params=b changeSettings(java.lang.Object,\ java.lang.String) comment9.text= \ Changes\ the\ settings\ of\ the\ calculator.\ \ The\ only\ setting\ that\ can \ be\ changed\ in\ this\ model\ is\ sticky\ bases.\ \ If\ change\ is\ of \ type\ {@link\ java.lang.Boolean},\ then\ bases\ are\ set\ to\ sticky\ iff\ the \ value\ of\ change\ is\ true.\ \ If\ change\ is\ of\ a\ different\ \ type,\ this\ method\ has\ no\ #BlueJ class context comment0.target=NumericDocument comment0.text= \ A\ Document\ for\ storing\ an\ arbitrarily\ large\ number\ in\ an\ arbitrary\ base, \ 2-36. \ @author\ Rod\ Howell \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ (howell@cis.ksu.edu) comment1.params=b\ s comment1.target=NumericDocument(int,\ java.lang.String) comment1.text= \ Constructs\ a\ new\ NumericDocument. \ @param\ b\ \ The\ radix\ in\ which\ the\ numeric\ content\ is\ represented. \ @param\ s\ \ The\ initial\ content\ of\ the\ document. comment2.params=offs\ str\ a comment2.target=void\ insertString(int,\ java.lang.String,\ javax.swing.text.AttributeSet) comment2.text= \ Inserts\ the\ given\ String\ into\ the\ document,\ removing\ any\ illegal \ characters. \ @param\ offs\ \ The\ offset\ at\ which\ the\ String\ is\ inserted. \ @param\ str\ \ \ The\ String\ to\ be\ inserted. \ @param\ a\ \ \ \ The\ attributes\ for\ the\ inserted\ content. \ @throws\ \ \ BadLocationException\ \ If\ offs\ does\ not\ represent\ a\ valid \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ insertion\ location. comment3.params= comment3.target=boolean\ isModified() comment3.text= \ Returns\ true\ iff\ this\ NumericDocument\ has\ been\ modified\ since\ its \ creation. comment4.params=offs\ len comment4.target=void\ remove(int,\ int) comment4.text= \ Removes\ the\ specified\ substring\ from\ this\ NumericDocument.\ \ If\ the \ content\ has\ not\ been\ modified\ since\ its\ creation,\ the\ removal\ is \ suppressed.\ \ This\ forces\ the\ first\ modification\ to\ be\ an\ insertion, \ which\ in\ fact\ replaces\ any\ content\ entirely. \ @throws\ BadLocationException\ \ If\ the\ given\ remove\ position\ is\ not \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ a\ valid\ position\ within\ the\ document. numComments=5

#BlueJ class context comment0.target=Operation comment0.text= \ An\ interface\ abstracting\ any\ operation.\ \ The\ operation\ may\ be \ explicitly\ encoded\ in\ an\ implementing\ subclass,\ or\ may\ defer\ the \ operation\ to\ some\ method\ receiving\ the\ Operation\ as\ a\ parameter. \ Arithmetic\ operations\ should\ be\ encoded\ explicitly;\ in\ this\ case, \ subclasses\ should\ implement\ {@link\ EncodedOperation}.\ \ In\ this\ way, \ the\ encoding\ of\ an\ arithmetic\ operation\ can\ be\ decoupled\ from\ the \ control\ of\ evaluation\ order. \ @author\ Rod\ Howell \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ (howell@cis.ksu.edu) comment1.params= comment1.target=int\ numOperands() comment1.text= \ @return\ the\ number\ of\ operands\ required\ by\ this\ Operation. numComments=2

#BlueJ class context comment0.target=GUI comment0.text= \ This\ is\ the\ driver\ class\ for\ the\ arbitrary-precision\ integer\ calculator. \ It\ may\ be\ run\ either\ as\ an\ application\ or\ an\ applet.\ \ When\ run\ as \ an\ application,\ it\ accepts\ two\ optional\ command-line\ arguments.\ \ The \ first\ is\ the\ name\ of\ the\ package\ containing\ the\ classes\ implementing \ the\ calculator\ model.\ \ The\ name\ must\ be\ terminated\ by\ a\ period.\ \ If \ omitted,\ EDU.ksu.cis.calculator.defaultmodel.\ is\ used.\ \ The \ second\ command-line\ argument\ gives\ the\ name\ of\ a\ class\ implementing \ the\ user\ interface\ to\ be\ used.\ \ This\ class\ must\ implement\ the \ interface\ {@link\ CalculatorUI}.\ \ If\ omitted,\ the\ class\ \ {@link\ DefaultUI}\ is\ used.\ \ If\ packages\ other\ than\: \
    \
  • \ {@link\ EDU.ksu.cis.calculator.defaultmodel}\ or \
  • \ {@link\ EDU.ksu.cis.calculator.javamodel} \
\ are\ used\ for\ the\ calculator\ model,\ or\ if\ classes\ other\ than\ \ {@link\ DefaultUI}\ are\ used\ for\ the\ user\ interface,\ care\ must\ be\ taken \ that\ the\ model\ package\ provides\ all\ of\ the\ classes\ required\ by\ the \ user\ interface\ class.\ \ See\ {@link\ DefaultUI}\ for\ more\ details. \ When\ run\ as\ an\ applet,\ these\ values\ can\ be\ passed\ using\ the\ following \ param\ tags\: \
    \
  • \ ModelLocation\:\ Package\ containing\ the\ model \
  • \ UIName\:\ Class\ name\ of\ the\ user\ interface \
